sources.title: Parry 1995S Small Electric Nacho & Popcorn Warmer Cabinet - Advantage Catering Equipment
Parry 1995S Commercial Nacho Warmer - Easy Equipment

1995s.summary: A small freestanding countertop warming cabinet with a heated base and an overhead lamp, for holding popcorn, nachos and similar dry snacks at serving temperature for impulse sales. It plugs into a normal socket and is not intended to heat food from cold or to hold wet items like cheese sauce.

highlights.text: Heated base and internal lighting with simple on/off switch; serving hatch and removable top for refilling.
Holding cabinet only: food must already be at serving temperature.

facts.label: Construction
facts.value: Stainless steel and toughened safety glass

facts.label: Plug
facts.value: Moulded plug (may alternatively be connected to a fused spur)
